composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Runs first. When the request carries an 'Idempotency-Key' already seen, publish the
# originally created owner and branch to respond 200 (no duplicate is created); otherwise
# publish the key (possibly absent) and continue to validate.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotentCreate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validate
  outputs:
    existing: respondExisting

# Respond 200 with the originally created owner for a repeated idempotent create.
respondExisting:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]

# Validate before Build so a missing or blank field is a 400 naming the offending
# fields, and the body is read (and republished) exactly once here.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Reject creating an owner whose identityKey (SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|
# soundex(lastName)) equals an existing non-deleted owner's, responding 409. Runs after
# validate so the email-domain blocklist and telephone normalization are already applied.
# This is the single duplicate-detection check; there is no separate household-duplicate block.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

# Reject creating an owner when the request's city already contains 50 or more owners,
# responding 409.
ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyCreateLimit

# Reject creating an owner once 100 or more owners have already been created today
# (by registrationDate), responding 429.
ensureDailyCreateLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyCreateLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

# Assign the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customerCode: REGION is the region derived from the
# postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-hex chars of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone +
# lastName). A stable identity with no sequence number.
assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Stamp the deterministic householdId (first 12 hex of SHA-256 of normalizedLastName|postcode)
# so owners with the same lastName + postcode share it automatically. Null when no postcode.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Count existing owners (before this create) sharing the same firstName + lastName
# (case-insensitive) and record it as namesakeCount before Save.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Record the new owner against its 'Idempotency-Key' (if any) so a later repeat with the
# same key returns this owner instead of creating a duplicate. Runs after Save so the id exists.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotentCreate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT log line carrying the owner id, customerCode and registrationDate.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: warn

# Flag whether more than 80 owners were created for this owner's registration day. Runs
# after Save so the new owner is counted, matching what a later GET recomputes.
warn:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: householdSize

# Record the owner's household size (owners sharing its householdId, including itself).
# Runs after Save so the new owner is counted, driving the 'GOLD' tier (3+ members) and
# matching what a later GET recomputes.
householdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: membershipLevel

# Cap the owner's membershipLevel at one above the current maximum among the other members of
# its household. Runs after householdSize (the level depends on it) so the capped value matches
# what a later GET recomputes.
membershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: possibleDuplicate

# Flag whether this owner soft-matches an existing owner's lastName + postcode with a
# different telephone (not a hard duplicate). Runs after Save so the same value is
# recomputed by a later GET; records possibleDuplicate and possibleDuplicateOf.
possibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it drives the derived salutation. One of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed address (the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present); otherwise it is the normalized flat address. Accepted on input for backward compatibility.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat address when present. Normalized like address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized like address and, when present, appended to addressLine1 (single space) to form the composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region via a fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied, drives the derived ageBand, which is computed as the owner's age on the registrationDate. ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Retained for backward compatibility. Duplicate detection is now the single identityKey (SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)); there is no separate household-duplicate block for this flag to bypass, so it no longer affects creation. Request-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner

## Summary

I added a `capacityWarning` flag that is `true` when an owner's city already holds 40–49 owners (approaching the hard limit of 50), leaving the existing 50-owner hard rejection untouched.

Changes:

1. **`model/Owner.java`** — added a `@Transient Boolean capacityWarning` field (derived at response time, never persisted) with getter/setter, mirroring `bulkSignupWarning`.

2. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added the `capacityWarning` boolean property to the owner schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field and MapStruct auto-maps it by name.

3. **`rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerCapacityWarning.java`** (new) — counts owners in the owner's city and sets the flag when the count is in `[40, 49]`. It reuses `EnsureCityCapacity.CAPACITY` (50) so the warning band derives from the hard limit and stays in sync.

4. **`officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** and **`.../owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml`** — inserted a `capacityWarning` step after the bulk-signup `warn` step in both pipelines. It runs after Save (create) and on read, counting all owners in the city including this one, so the flag is identical whether returned from the create response or a later GET — matching the pattern used by the other derived flags.

The test fills a fresh city to 40 owners, creates one more (making 41, within the 40–49 band), and asserts `capacityWarning` is `true` on the subsequent GET — which now holds.
